lines.t: Yeah…
When the night get long and the soul feel thin…
Don’t fold.
The LORD still reign.
Let’s go.
I ain’t losin’ hope, no, I’m holdin’ on,
Storm in my chest but the throne stay strong,
When my flesh get weak, His grace move on,
LORD be my strength when the whole world gone.
I ain’t losin’ hope, I’m trustin’ His hand,
Fire in the valley, still I know who I am,
No chain on my soul, no fear gon’ stand,
He made the sky and the dirt that I stand.
Look—
Pressure on pressure, the bills and the battles,
Mind full of noise and the heart full of gravel,
People be talkin’, but talk is a rattle,
They ain’t been down where the dark make you travel.
I was lookin’ at the mountain like, “How can I climb it?”
Lookin’ at the clock like, “LORD, why You time it?”
Lookin’ at my wounds, tryin’ hard to hide it,
Then the Word cut through: “Son, don’t deny it.”
My hope ain’t in a check, ain’t in a plan,
Ain’t in a woman, a friend, or a man,
Ain’t in the praise when the crowd clap hands,
My hope in the LORD, that’s the rock where I stand.
Heaven and earth by the strength of His arm,
Nothing too hard when He step in the storm,
I was built in the fire, not raised in the calm,
Every scar got a lesson, every trial got a Psalm.
When I’m empty, He fill me,
When I’m shaking, He still me,
When the dark try to kill me,
His mercy come real, G.
I ain’t losin’ hope, no, I’m holdin’ on,
Storm in my chest but the throne stay strong,
When my flesh get weak, His grace move on,
LORD be my strength when the whole world gone.
I ain’t losin’ hope, I’m trustin’ His hand,
Fire in the valley, still I know who I am,
No chain on my soul, no fear gon’ stand,
He made the sky and the dirt that I stand.
No, I don’t need fake smiles, no plastic religion,
No sugar on pain, no soft superstition,
I need the Most High, His clear provision,
His truth in my mouth, His Word my position.
‘Cause a man get tired, yeah, that part real,
Heart get cut and the scars don’t heal,
But the LORD don’t leave when the pain get steel,
He turn weak knees into boots on the field.
“Be not dismayed,” that’s a war cry loud,
Not because I’m tough, not because I’m proud,
But He said, “I am with thee,” so I stand unbowed,
Even tears in my eyes, I won’t worship the crowd.
Due season comin’, don’t faint, don’t quit,
Seed in the ground while the dark talk slick,
Patience build proof when the pressure get thick,
Hope don’t shame when the Spirit hit quick.
I done learned: the delay ain’t abandonment,
The silence ain’t proof of a broken covenant,
The valley ain’t home, it’s a training event,
And the enemy loud ‘cause his time gettin’ spent.
My flesh and my heart may fail—
But You are my strength…
My flesh and my heart may fail—
But You are my portion…
I’m not waiting on a feeling.
I’m standing on what He said.
Grace is sufficient.
The LORD is my refuge.
The LORD is my strength.
I ain’t losin’ hope, no, I’m holdin’ on,
Storm in my chest but the throne stay strong,
When my flesh get weak, His grace move on,
LORD be my strength when the whole world gone.
I ain’t losin’ hope, I’m trustin’ His hand,
Fire in the valley, still I know who I am,
No chain on my soul, no fear gon’ stand,
He made the sky and the dirt that I stand.
When I got no might, He give strength.
When I got no road, He make one.
When the night get heavy…
My hope is in the LORD.
Forever.
